experiment: S7 anticipatory selection audit: Bellman vs myopic tie-breaks, no transfer

design.scenario: central S7 opportunity, T=4, C5 Markov demand
design.CDM_rule: maximize immediate CES; within absolute tolerance 1e-12, maximize positive competence increments only for skill coordinates with positive requirements in current observed demand; remaining ties canonical action key
design.future_demand_information: used by Bellman optimization only; unavailable to MA, BMA, and CDM selectors
design.BMA_rule: maximize immediate CES; ties maximize total positive immediate competence increment; canonical action key for remaining ties

profile.organizational_problem: anticipatory competence development under Markov demand
profile.constraints: central S7 production and shared resource constraints; teaching unavailable
profile.information_regime: current competence and current demand observed; future demand law known to Bellman only
profile.aggregation_rules: exact expectation over all C5 paths, one demanded service per period
